title: How we price — Sturij
description: Materials at the price we pay, with our discounts passed on. We charge for what we make and fit. The quote shows every line.

source.part: Part 7 — How we price (Mark's decision cf496e63)

parts.heading: Materials at cost. We charge for what we make and fit.

standfirst.text: We've only ever earned money one way — by doing our own work well. So the price is built the way the furniture is: from the parts, in the open.

blocks.title: Materials at the price we pay.

lines.text: Every board, hinge, runner, handle and fitting goes on your quote at the price we buy it for — with our trade and volume discounts passed on to you, and no margin added. We don't hold stock; materials are ordered for your job and typically arrive the next day, so there's nothing to mark up and no reason to.
Manufacturing — the cutting, edging and assembly in our Skelmanthorpe workshop; delivery; and installation by the people who built it. That's where our expertise is, and that's what you pay us for.

blocks.title: Where a job needs more, we say so.

lines.text: On larger projects, or where a job calls for project-management time, or sourcing, finishing or preparing materials beyond the ordinary — a special finish, a hard-to-find fitting, boards prepared before they're cut — we may charge up to 10% of the trade cost of those materials for the extra work in the supply process. It's on the quote as its own line, with the reason, or it isn't charged.
Out-of-pocket costs — a courier, a delivery charge, a specialist's call-out — are passed on as they are, with the receipt.

blocks.title: Why we do it this way.

lines.text: Because a price you can read is a price you can trust. Your quote shows the materials at cost, our manufacturing, delivery and installation, any supply charge with its reason, and expenses — nothing else. We think that transparency is the foundation of a job that goes well, for you and for us.
Priced from the cutting list, not a price book. If a line on your quote isn't clear, ask — we'd rather explain it than have you wonder.

extra.short: Guide prices are honest bands from recent projects. Your quote is built from the cutting list: materials at the price we pay, our manufacturing, delivery and installation, and any extras stated with their reason. No margin on materials.
